name: DotGrid
description: "N out of M" made visible: a grid of `total` dots that appear, then light one by one up to `lit` from `at`, with a live count and labels under the grid once lighting starts. Whole rows (10 x 10 for 100) sized to fill the clip box.

total.description: how many dots; 10, 20, 50 or 100 read at a glance

lit.description: how many light up (rounded, at most total)

label_lit.description: legend after the live count of lit dots, e.g. go to tax

label_rest.description: legend for the unlit rest, e.g. stay in your pocket

counter.description: show the live count line even without label_lit

at.description: Time the lighting starts: "line:12" or seconds from the clip start. The count and legend show from then. Default: 0.27 s into the clip

dur.description: seconds to light them all; default: until 55% of the clip

columns.description: force the column count; default: the biggest dots in whole rows, rows of ten when they fit

color.description: lit colour: theme token or CSS

ground.description: what it sits on; sets unlit dot and text colours
